value.name: prepares for Monday
value.description: Asha gets up, makes coffee, reviews the Monday agenda twice, makes no changes, and dresses at six.
evidence: she got up and made coffee and sat at the kitchen table with the agenda for Monday in front of her and read it through once and then again, and she crossed out nothing and added nothing, and at six she got dressed.

value.name: walks to Spruce Street house
value.description: On a cold, bright Monday morning, Asha walks from her apartment to the office and then to the house on Spruce Street.
evidence: Monday morning was cold and bright.
She walked from her apartment to the office and from the office, at ten-forty, to the house on Spruce Street
value.location_hint: from apartment to office to house on Spruce Street

value.name: marks arrival as different
value.description: Asha pauses on the stoop to consciously mark this visit as different from previous arrivals.
evidence: she stood on the stoop for a moment before she rang the bell, because she wanted to mark, to herself, that this was a different arrival from the arrivals before.
value.location_hint: stoop of the house on Spruce Street

value.name: reflects on case developments
value.description: Asha mentally notes that the codicil has been filed, the buyers are gone, the appraisal is in, the structures have been circulated, and the siblings have made their decision.
evidence: The codicil had been filed. The buyers were gone. The appraisal was in. The structures had been circulated. The siblings had decided what they had decided.

value.name: accepts reduced role
value.description: Asha recognizes that whatever happens next will occur in a room she helped make possible, but she will not be the most important person there today.
evidence: Whatever was going to happen now was going to happen inside a room she had helped to make possible but in which she would not, today, be the most important person.

value.name: rings the bell
value.description: Asha rings the bell at the Spruce Street house.

value.name: Rosa opens the door
value.description: Rosa answers the door and appears in a new sweater, with her hair pinned differently and a coffee cup in hand.
evidence: Rosa was wearing a sweater Asha had not seen before, a soft gray one, and her hair was pinned differently, and she was holding a coffee cup, which Asha had also not seen her do
value.location_hint: doorway of the house on Spruce Street

value.name: Rosa invites Asha inside
value.description: Rosa steps back, tells Asha the others are in the dining room, and explains that she brought pastries as herself rather than as the housekeeper.
evidence: she stepped back from the door and said, "Come in, Asha. They are in the dining room. I brought pastries this morning, which I did not bring as the housekeeper. I brought them as a person who likes pastries. I want to be clear about that before you eat one."

value.name: Asha accepts pastry terms
value.description: Asha agrees to eat a pastry under Rosa's stated terms.
evidence: "I will eat one on those terms," Asha said.
